game.name: Deathsmiles II (Japan)
game.desc: Deathsmiles II is a shooting game for Xbox 360 in which you can play as young ladies shooting anything that moves on the screen. In addition to the traditional power-ups, waves of enemies and bosses, there are 3 difficulty levels and six playable characters.
